secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google AI Studio API key used by google-genai to write the headline and Thai voiceover script (model gemini-2.5-flash). Without it the app falls back to a canned Thai script. Get it at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey

secrets.name: FAL_KEY
secrets.description: fal.ai API key used for image-to-video generation (fal-ai/minimax/video-01). Without it /generate cannot produce a source clip unless one is placed in raw_footages/. Get it at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Optional. Supabase project URL; when set together with SUPABASE_KEY every generated video is logged to the video_histories table.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Supabase service/anon key paired with SUPABASE_URL for the video_histories log.
